key_features: Up to 4x More Capacity: Supports MU-MIMO and OFDMA to reduce congestion and quadruple the average throughput.
Extensive Coverage: 6× high-performance antennas with beamforming technology ensure broad coverage.
More Vents, Long-Lasting Performance: Contemporary design that also acts as a vent area to unleash the full power of performance.
USB Sharing: 1× USB 3.0 port enables easy media sharing and private cloud building.
Easy Setup: Set up the router in minutes with guided instructions using the Tether app.
